title: Architecture Decision Record (Nygard-style skeleton with frontmatter)

consequences.description: Records the three poles of the Nygard format: positive, negative and neutral. Validation does not depend on the ADR's creation date or edit history.

neutral.description: Neutral consequences that come with adoption

confirmation.description: spec-detail (2026-07-09): from MADR (optional). Declares the means of mechanically confirming that this decision is kept (fitness function / grep / test). artifacts/architecture-contract/semantics.md §18 is the SoT.

decision_bindings.description: Project-root-relative files that bind this decision at run time. For an accepted ADR, each file states the ADR id explicitly as a decision_ref or a comment, and is also included in source_paths.
